lead-v2-dark.svg: synthwerk-infra starts the Synthwerk spine on one machine: edge, WAF, bus, database and telemetry. docker compose up --wait returns when every health check is green. Pulse joins in the next PR.
lead-v2-light.svg: synthwerk-infra starts the Synthwerk spine on one machine: edge, WAF, bus, database and telemetry. docker compose up --wait returns when every health check is green. Pulse joins in the next PR.

features-v2-dark.svg: EDGE: Traefik v3 with a rate limit, a 1 MiB body limit and the Coraza WAF with OWASP CRS v4. BUS AND DATABASE: NATS JetStream and PostgreSQL 18 on an internal network. No host ports. TELEMETRY: grafana/otel-lgtm takes OTLP on 4317 and 4318. Grafana on localhost:3000
features-v2-light.svg: EDGE: Traefik v3 with a rate limit, a 1 MiB body limit and the Coraza WAF with OWASP CRS v4. BUS AND DATABASE: NATS JetStream and PostgreSQL 18 on an internal network. No host ports. TELEMETRY: grafana/otel-lgtm takes OTLP on 4317 and 4318. Grafana on localhost:3000
what-v2-dark.svg: One command: docker compose up --wait starts edge, WAF, bus, database, telemetry and a stub backend. Health checks: Every container has one. CI fails when one service is not healthy in 300 s. WAF test: SQL injection, path traversal and XSS through the edge get 403. A benign request gets 200. No secrets: scripts/init-env.sh writes .env with random dev passwords. .env is git-ignored

setup-v2-dark.svg: scripts/init-env.sh: Copy .env.example to .env. Fill each empty password with a random value. docker compose up --wait: Build the WAF, start the stack, return when all services are healthy. tests/stack/stack_test.sh: Check health, WAF blocks, limits and fail-closed behaviour. docker compose --profile ollama up --wait: Also start Ollama for local models. Off by default

startnotes-v2-dark.svg: Needs: Docker with Compose v2 or later, openssl and curl. Go 1.27 only to work on the WAF. First start: Builds the WAF image and pulls about 2 GB of images. Later starts take about 30 s
startnotes-v2-light.svg: Needs: Docker with Compose v2 or later, openssl and curl. Go 1.27 only to work on the WAF. First start: Builds the WAF image and pulls about 2 GB of images. Later starts take about 30 s
flow-v2-dark.svg: CLIENT -> EDGE -> WAF -> SERVICE. Traefik asks the WAF first. 200 passes the request on. 403 goes back to the client.
flow-v2-light.svg: CLIENT -> EDGE -> WAF -> SERVICE. Traefik asks the WAF first. 200 passes the request on. 403 goes back to the client.
how-v2-dark.svg: 403: A CRS rule blocked the request. Edge and WAF logs hold no query values, no body and no client IP. 413 and 429: Body over 1 MiB, or more than 50 requests per second from one IP (burst 100). 500: The WAF did not answer. The edge fails closed and lets nothing through
how-v2-light.svg: 403: A CRS rule blocked the request. Edge and WAF logs hold no query values, no body and no client IP. 413 and 429: Body over 1 MiB, or more than 50 requests per second from one IP (burst 100). 500: The WAF did not answer. The edge fails closed and lets nothing through

config-v2-dark.svg: SYNTHWERK_<SERVICE>_<NAME>: Every setting is an env var with this shape (D-40). See .env.example. SYNTHWERK_PLATFORM_ENV, OTEL_*: Environment name (local here). Services get the standard OTEL_* names from compose. SYNTHWERK_WAF_ENGINE: On blocks. DetectionOnly logs matches without blocking. SYNTHWERK_WAF_PARANOIA_LEVEL: CRS paranoia level, 1 to 4. Default 1
